scope: Seven real local jobs; six relationships checked and six saved outcomes retrieved

outcomes.title: Shuffle the library
outcomes.question: Does row order change the scientific result?
outcomes.expectation: Same graph identities, descriptors and selected graph identities after reversing row order.
observations: Graph identities and complete property records were preserved.

outcomes.title: Change the spelling
outcomes.question: Does equivalent recorded notation preserve the descriptors?
outcomes.expectation: Canonical isomeric spellings retain graph identities and property records. Selection is not asserted: raw-input tie-breaks may change.
observations: Graph identities and complete property records were preserved.
This test makes no claim about canonicalization beyond these specific spellings.

outcomes.title: Plant a duplicate
outcomes.question: Will a duplicate quietly count as a new candidate?
outcomes.expectation: The duplicate is retained with the same graph identity and properties; ranking is withheld.
observations: Duplicate row retained; original records unchanged; both selections withheld.

outcomes.title: Break one input
outcomes.question: Will a broken record vanish from the comparison?
outcomes.expectation: Replace the first row with an empty record. Preserve every row; reject that row, withhold its descriptors and all selections.
observations: The empty row stayed in the library; no numeric value or shortlist was published for it. Other rows were preserved.

outcomes.title: Move the budget
outcomes.question: Does changing the budget secretly change the scores?
outcomes.expectation: Same molecular rows and full rankings; the new selections are exact prefixes at the new budget.
observations: Budget 2 → 3; properties and full rankings unchanged; selections are exact prefixes.

outcomes.title: Forge a number
outcomes.question: Can a changed number pass after its checksum is rebuilt?
outcomes.expectation: Change molecular weight by +1 and rebuild the result hash. Fresh server replay must fail with replay_result_mismatch.
observations: Fresh replay rejected the changed value despite its internally consistent checksum.
